args.title: Summary: Brightline cold-chain logistics articles (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion):

- In 2026, temperature excursions fell 30% at cold-chain carriers that shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- The companion piece reports that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
